sections.html:
Englewood is a compact city in western Arapahoe County, directly south of Denver in the South Platte valley. It covers about 6.6 square miles at 5,348 feet. The 2020 census counted 33,659 residents, up from 30,255 in 2010, and the estimate for July 1, 2025 is 35,305. Density is high, at 5,127 people per square mile in 2020.

Homes here lean small. Households average 2.01 people, and 49.2% of homes are owner-occupied. The median owner-occupied value is $572,900 and median gross rent is $1,668 (2020 to 2024). Many Englewood sellers own a small house or condo, and many are landlords. Treat the median as a benchmark, not a price for your property.

Broadway and Hampden Avenue split the city into four quadrants, and each has its own housing mix.

  • Northwest: the oldest section, with downtown, City Center and housing from the 1910s. A former General Iron site awaits redevelopment.
  • Southwest: newer housing alongside many industrial facilities, plus Belleview Park.
  • Southeast: almost entirely residential, newer than the north and southwest, reaching the Highline Canal.
  • Northeast: the hospital complex with Swedish Medical Center and Craig Hospital.

Hampden Hills is the newest and wealthiest part of the city and has many apartment complexes. Because housing age varies so much from quadrant to quadrant, buyers and inspectors will ask how old the systems in your house are. Know the answer before they do.

An older population with small households means estates and downsizing are common. People aged 65 and over are 15.0% of residents, and 80.7% of people lived in the same house a year earlier. Heirs who live out of state and inherit an Englewood house often want a clean sale without managing repairs from a distance.

Arapahoe County bills Englewood property tax under the state calendar. Colorado statute 39-10-104.5 sets the dates.

Payment optionDue dateRule
First halfOn or before the last day of FebruaryInstallments under $25 cannot be split
Second halfJune 15Late amounts accrue 1% interest per month
Single paymentOn or before the last day of AprilSmall bills must be paid in full by April 30

Interest on late amounts runs at 1% per month, and any part of a month counts as a whole month. Call the Arapahoe County Treasurer to confirm the current rule and your balance.

The title company prorates the current year's tax through the closing date. Unpaid taxes from earlier years must be cleared before the deed can transfer cleanly. Ask the Treasurer or the title company for a payoff figure early, so a balance does not surprise you on closing day.

Englewood requires every short-term rental operator to hold both a city sales and use tax license and a short-term rental license. In residential zones the operator must be the primary resident and live at the property at least 185 days a year.

  • An application needs a current deed on file with Arapahoe County, a notarized residency affidavit and two proofs of primary residence in residential zones.
  • Insurance must include at least $1 million in personal liability coverage.
  • Parking must include one permanent space per rented bedroom, with no more than two on the street.
  • Fees rose January 1, 2026: $600 for a new application and $400 for a renewal, plus $75 for inspection and $200 at issuance.

A house that cannot meet these conditions may be worth less to a buyer who planned to rent it nightly, so check the license status before pricing.

Englewood Public Schools serves most of the city, with small portions in Littleton Public Schools and Sheridan Public Schools. The Englewood station on RTD's D Line sits in the Civic Center, and mean travel time to work was 22.6 minutes for 2020 to 2024. Annual precipitation is only 10.42 inches, but wide temperature swings are hard on roofs and exterior finishes.

sections.h2: Selling a house that was a nightly rental
sections.html: If you ran the house as a short-term rental, a buyer will ask whether the licenses were in place and whether you met the residency rule. Keep both licenses, the residency affidavit and proof of the insurance coverage in one folder. A house that cannot meet the conditions today is worth less to a buyer who planned to rent it nightly, and that difference should show up in the price. A buyer who just wants to live in it, or rent it long term, cares much less.

An estate sale is one of the most common reasons for a quick sale in Englewood. Heirs often live elsewhere, and a house with an unfinished repair or old systems becomes a monthly worry. Gather the documents that show who can sign, then give the title company the list of names early. It will tell you what else it needs and how signing works for someone who is out of state.

A cash purchase spares the heirs repairs, showings and the cost of keeping the house up while the paperwork moves.

sections.h2: Steps in an Englewood cash sale
sections.html:
1. You tell us about the property and its condition.
  2. We review it and make a written offer.
  3. If you agree, the title company runs a search, asks the Arapahoe County Treasurer about taxes and prepares the deed.
  4. You choose a closing date and sign.
  5. The deed is recorded with the county and you are paid.

An offer is not a commitment. You can compare it with a listing and decline with no cost.

sections.h2: How do you sell an Englewood house fast?
sections.html:
You can list with an agent, sell on your own or take a cash purchase. A listing may bring the highest price on a house in good shape. A cash sale is faster for a house that needs work, has tenants or sits in an estate.

Colorado's documentary fee on a deed is $0.01 per $100 of consideration over $500. We buy houses in Englewood and nearby Arapahoe County in any condition. Tell us about the property and you will get an answer. If you say no, you owe nothing.

faqs.q: What is the median home value in Englewood?
faqs.a: The 2020 to 2024 median value of owner-occupied homes in Englewood is $572,900. Treat it as a benchmark, since each house differs.
Englewood is in Arapahoe County, where its deeds are recorded and its property taxes are billed.

faqs.q: Do I need a license for an Airbnb in Englewood?
faqs.a: Yes. You need a city sales and use tax license and a short-term rental license, and in residential zones you must live at the property at least 185 days a year.

faqs.q: When are Colorado property taxes due for an Englewood house?
faqs.a: State law allows two halves, due by the last day of February and by June 15, or a single payment by the last day of April.

faqs.q: Can I sell an Englewood house with an unfinished repair?
faqs.a: Yes. A cash buyer purchases the house as it stands, so unfinished work does not have to be completed before closing.
